note: What each playground page is about, in the words a reader would search for.
`topic` leads the page's title, as in "Arrays in iyi: a runnable example".
`about` is the first sentence of the page's description. A tour program's
own first comment line is that sentence already, so a tour entry has none;
a repository sample opens with a line written for someone reading the
repository ("The first program that forgets - a table of..."), cut
mid-sentence or ending on a SPEC.md section, so every `iyi/` entry carries
one. src/playground/samples.ts refuses a page with no entry, and an entry

iyi/basics.about: The first half hour of iyi: what a person writes before they write anything real

iyi/calc.about: A calculator language with variables, written in iyi: the biggest of the sample programs

iyi/collections.about: The Enumerable trait from the standard library, implemented twice, with every method called

iyi/config.about: Reading a key = value config file, with the line number in its error

iyi/derive.about: A derive macro, and where it runs: once, in the module that declares the type

iyi/enums.about: An enum used the way a program uses one: its values, comparing members, printing them

iyi/errors.about: Errors are ordinary union members: no Result wrapper and no exception hierarchy

iyi/files.about: Write a file, read it back, check that it exists, then delete it

iyi/format.about: Format strings: width, alignment, padding, precision, and bases

iyi/formatting.about: Negative indexing, numbers in any base, and padding with rjust, ljust and repeat

iyi/generics.about: Implementing a trait for a generic type

iyi/grid.about: A table of cells built from their coordinates, read across, down and along the diagonal

iyi/hello.about: The first iyi program: structs, traits and impls in one file, and what is still missing

iyi/immutable.about: The standard library's shareable immutable sequence, and the evidence that it cannot change

iyi/init_order.about: Module initialization order: a module initializes after every module it imports

iyi/inventory.about: A list of structs and the questions a list gets asked: which ones, how many, the largest

iyi/io.about: Reading standard input one line at a time

iyi/modules.about: Modules across files: import, and the names it brings into scope

iyi/sessions.about: A table of who is signed in, which loses an entry when somebody signs out

iyi/shapes.about: Two structs behind one trait, held in a list typed by the trait, their areas added up

iyi/socket.about: A TCP client and server in one program, on loopback

iyi/std_iterator.about: Lazy sequences with std/iterator: elements transformed on demand, when pulled

iyi/std_text.about: Text processing with the standard library's std/text

iyi/std_time.about: std/time: wall clock, monotonic stopwatch, civil calendar, and RFC 3339

iyi/visited.about: A walk over a graph with cycles that ends because it keeps a set of where it has been

iyi/webapp.about: The Sinatra feel, kept: routes written by the app rather than injected by the library
